quests.title: Sky Pillar Peak: the Four Island trial (Team Rocket takes Rayquaza)
Sky Pillar Peak: Rayquaza (post-game, Jade Orb)

acquisitions.conditions: After the final Hall of Fame and Lance’s visit to your house in Pallet Town. Carry the Jade Orb and examine the far north end of Sky Pillar Peak. One chance: catching it, knocking it out or fleeing removes it; only losing allows a retry.
